subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR13: 'If the file description entry associated with the write file contains the LINAGE clause, mnemonic-name-1 shall not be specified.' (--check OK). CheckWriteAdvancingMnemonic errors (COBOL0862) when file.Linage is set and the ADVANCING dataReference resolves in the unit's mnemonic registry. Probe ws1mnlin (LINAGE + AFTER ADVANCING TOP-OF-FORM, C01) -> 0862; ws1mnok (same, no LINAGE) compiles. Keyed files never reach it but Format 2 has no ADVANCING at all (SR3, COBOL1720). Both BEFORE and AFTER share the one adv context, so both words are covered. [editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023 (base WRITE statement; the 2023 text records no change to this rule in Annex E)]
